description:
In src/compiler2/types/mod.rs the element, payload and field projections clone or build whole descriptors to fold them: list element type (lines ~3735-3756: clause_elem.unwrap_or_else(Descr::any), ~4,900 Descr::any constructions and ~4,700 descriptor clones via line 3753), resource_payload_type (3758-3780; Descr::any at 3765, ~4,900), tuple field projection (3805-3840: cx.descr(t).clone() per field at 3826, ~3,500; 3840 ~1,300; Descr::any at 3805 ~2,100). A descriptor clone or Descr::any costs several allocations (ten axis vectors/sets).

Change: fold through borrows (Cow or Option<&Descr> for the single-positive case, the pattern list_clause_empty and tuple_clause_empty already use in types/emptiness.rs); answer the no-positive case (any) without building Descr::any per clause where the union with any is any. Results are identical descriptors.

Evidence: allocation census of the OptionParser probe at bf51f11c1 (develop ac3750d1e + hasher fix + fz-y11.15 spike; 857,327 calls). Ranked sites: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/464fcf92-8f92-4767-a8fb-4e4eea4b6d45/scratchpad/census/bf51f11c1_top.txt; call chains: python3 /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/464fcf92-8f92-4767-a8fb-4e4eea4b6d45/scratchpad/census/chain.py /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/464fcf92-8f92-4767-a8fb-4e4eea4b6d45/scratchpad/census/bf51f11c1.pkl <file:line> <depth>. Counts are 1-in-16 sampling estimates; line numbers are at that commit. Method and signal: see the epic (bw show fz-y11). Every site is a claim read from the census and the source, to be confirmed first.
title: A type projection reads the descriptors it unions without copying them
